Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/ay-accounts/

Aphrody OS identity layer: Google OAuth 2.0 and Microsoft identity platform (Entra) sign-in with PKCE loopback and device code, scope catalogs, multiple accounts, token refresh and OS keyring storage.
